title: Sunflow optimizer profile
description: PV module optimizers of an integration that shows each optimizer as a Home Assistant device, and the entities of their values. Files under profiles/optimizers/.

name.description: Name of the source in the UI (e.g. the manufacturer).

url.description: Where to get the integration, if it is no core integration.

sub_device.description: Optimizers are sub-devices of their inverter.

exclude_identifier.description: Devices with this text in an identifier are no optimizer (e.g. sums over a string).

name_strip.description: Prefix removed from the device name.

label_position.description: Regular expression on the label whose two groups give string letter and module number ("A1": string A, module 1).

required.description: Values a device must have to count as optimizer.

additionalProperties.description: End of the entity's unique_id, matched like role keys ('_' or '-' before it, wildcards allowed); several matches: the shortest unique_id.
